bio: Jeck Da General is a DMV-area producer (Flow Union/The Supplerz) and the producer Black co-produced That Boy Hi Hat's Idol or Icon (2021) with; Black owns the rights to every That Boy Hi Hat track connected to Jeck Da General. His That Boy Hi Hat production credits include Flamerz (producer; co-produced with Black Lansky — Black-confirmed 2026-09-15), Shaka Zulu, Spirits n Shadows, and Rainbows And Roses (all co-produced with Black Lansky, per CWI's published articles). His instrumental albums (The Menu) are positioned as background-score sync assets, and his beats track Uptown appears in CWI's Oct 2023 new-releases roundup. Qobuz metadata lists Jeck Da General in production/composer roles on some That Boy Hi Hat tracks; per-track verification is still pending.
